name: Ravel cascade - everything is fuel
notes: The Ravel signature moment, isolated: one chain of detonating fuel wagons deletes a line - or their own. A Citizen line kills the nearest wagon, its blast reaches the next, and the cascade runs until it runs out of fuel. The wagons stand two columns apart and a row apart, each within the next one's blast (a radius of 2 is two columns either side and one row up and down, a row counting two columns), with a runner tucked in beside them. Chains are bounded because an entity can only die once, so the whole cascade resolves inside the tick that started it.
